The Story

A mechanical engineer who fell in love with the question: "Why do products fail people?"

At IIT Bombay, I was studying systems — how parts fit together, how forces flow, how failure happens. Then I started noticing the same patterns in software products. Not bugs. Not features. People.

That curiosity led me to research, design, and eventually ship products. I'm drawn to the intersection of user empathy, technical possibility, and business reality — that narrow space where truly useful products live.

The best PM work is invisible to the user — they just feel like the product gets them.
